records.trigger: Explicit behavior-change work: reviewer prompts currently instruct unconditional full decisions-directory scans, causing the token exhaustion this story fixes.
records.observedFailure: Both live templates (and their four mirrors) carry unconditional full-scan instructions: lattice-review-scope-plan.md:122 "Always scan the **full decisions/ directory**" (also lines 158/191) and lattice-review-behavior.md:126 "full directory scan of `<requirementsDir>/decisions/`" (also line 160). Every scope-plan/behavior reviewer run is therefore told to read all 111 decision docs (~2,400,226 bytes), with no bounded-preflight, candidateSpecSet, or scanEscalationReason wording present in any of the six copies.
records.failingCommand: sh -c '! rg -q -e "Always scan the \*\*full decisions/ directory\*\*" -e "full directory scan of" packages/main/templates/agents/lattice-review-scope-plan.md packages/main/templates/agents/lattice-review-behavior.md'
records.note: Red state = old unconditional full-scan wording present (rg finds it, so the negated command exits non-zero). Green = the new reviewer-scan-budget guard smoke passes over all six copies after the prompt rewrite; CHK-006 adversarial intent additionally demonstrates red by temporary reintroduction.
